resources.string: Key helper: off. Press OK to turn it on.
Each row is a remote button and what it opens. Press OK on a row to change the app or remove it.
Press the remote button you want to map. Back cancels.
A button another app handles is never seen here. If the launcher maps the same button, turn its mapping off first.
Turn Remote keys on in Settings, Accessibility.
Maps extra remote buttons to apps. Off unless you turn it on.
